svg.aria-label: Swap models without redeploys: the config-driven stack
svg.title: Swap models without redeploys: the config-driven stack
svg.desc: Four layers top to bottom. API Gateway is the stable front door: one URL, throttling, usage plans, never changes. Lambda reads the active model from AppConfig and calls it through the Converse API, which works across providers with one request shape. AppConfig holds the model choice as runtime config, with validation and gradual rollout. A side box adds the circuit breaker: on repeated model errors, route to a fallback model or cached answer, then probe the primary before switching back.
svg.text: NO REDEPLOY SWAPS: MODEL ID LIVES IN CONFIG, NOT CODE
stable front door: one URL, throttling, usage plans
clients never change when the model changes
reads active_model, calls Converse with that modelId
Converse works across providers with one shape
validation rules + gradual rollout + automatic rollback
repeated model errors -> fallback model or cached answer
probe the primary before switching back
Exam constraint: when the scenario says no code changes or no redeploy, only the config-driven pattern qualifies.
